chunks: Al-Husayn ibn 'Ubayd Allah informed me, from Abu Muhammad al-Husayn ibn Hamzah al-'Alawi, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Ali, from Abu Ibrahim عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the dead person who dies while in a state of janabah. He said: One ghusl is upon him.

key_terms.جُنُبٌ: in a state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person dies while in a state of janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased person who dies while in a state of janabah. The Imam عليه السلام states that a single ghusl suffices for such a deceased person, indicating the ruling for ritual washing in this case.
